Product & Software Requirements Specification (PRD / SRS)

Formal functional and non-functional requirements, user personas, role-based access controls, and service-level objectives for the Launch Up platform.

Status Approved & Deployed
Target SLA 99.95% Availability

1 Executive Summary & System Objectives

The Operational Challenge

Software agencies and incubators face fragmented workflows across separate dashboards: client intake forms, git repositories, multi-cloud hosting providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel), password managers, and billing systems. This leads to operational friction, slow deployment responses, and critical secret leakage risks.

The Launch Up Solution

A unified orchestration cockpit offering instant multi-tenant client onboarding, multi-cloud automated deployments, real-time terminal stdout streaming, 1-click zero-downtime rollbacks, AES-256-GCM secret vault isolation, and continuous git/database disaster recovery.

3 Functional Requirements Catalog (FR-01 to FR-06)

FR-01: Client Onboarding & Lifecycle Implemented
  • Classification of clients into B2B Enterprise and B2C Startup accounts.
  • SLA tier assignment (Tier 1: 99.99%, Tier 2: 99.9%, Tier 3: 99.5%).
  • Real-time Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) calculation and multi-project linkage.
FR-02: Project Orchestration & Repository Binding Implemented
  • Framework selectors (Next.js, React + Vite, Remix, Node.js, Python FastAPI).
  • Git repository binding with branch targeting (main, staging).
  • Health score algorithm (0–100%) tracking commit cadence and deployment pass rate.
FR-03: Multi-Cloud Deployment & 1-Click Rollback Implemented
  • 4 cloud targets: AWS ECS (Fargate), Google Cloud Run, Vercel Edge, and VPS.
  • Real-time stdout/stderr build log streaming with phase indicators.
  • Instantaneous 1-click rollback routing traffic back to previous stable release digests.
FR-04: Security Vault & Secret Isolation Implemented
  • AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with 96-bit unique IVs per tenant secret.
  • Zero browser key leakage; sensitive secrets sandboxed server-side.
  • HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for external webhooks.

4 Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) & Quality Attributes

NFR-01: Performance

60 FPS & < 16ms Latency

Sub-millisecond filtering with useMemo. Bundle gzipped size under 180KB.

NFR-02: Availability

99.95% Target Uptime

RTO under 15 minutes, RPO under 5 minutes via continuous WAL database streams.

NFR-03: Accessibility

WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant

Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio, keyboard focus trapping, and hotkey shortcuts.

NFR-04: Compatibility

Modern Evergreen Browsers

Tested across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari on desktop and tablet screens.
